{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-laol","title":"CCP sync/hop/desync/rendezvous vector consumers: 8 vector-vs-implementation divergences","description":"Consuming the four orphaned CCP vector files (python/tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py) surfaced divergences between pinned expectations and real lichen behavior. Real behavior is asserted green in the module; each vector-literal contradiction is xfail(strict=True) or documented-skip there.

1) DUAL CCP-12 CHANNEL MAPPING (interop hazard). lichen/link/channel.py:76-79 synchronized_hop_channel uses 1 + h % max(n_channels-1,1) (avoids CH0); lichen/sim/tdma.py:12-16 synchronized_hop_channel uses 1 + h % max(n,3) (spec 02a pseudocode). Identical input sfn=0/seed=0/8ch: link=4, sim=6. Consequence: test/vectors/sync_hop.json pins link values (e.g. channel 4) while test/vectors/ccp16-hop.json pins sim/spec values (hop_sfn0_8ch=6, sfn_wrap=2) for THE SAME inputs and identical hash_32 pins (2615243109/3025216001). The files cannot both hold for one implementation; today two disagreeing implementations coexist in-tree.

2) ccp9-rendezvous.json hash_based_peer_rendezvous expected_channel=4 is unreachable by runtime code. The real priority-3 surface lichen/link/channel.py:126-137 hashes eui||epoch_le||sfn_le -> FNV(aabbccddeeff0011||00000000||3039le)=3655666340 -> channel 5 at epoch=0. Channel 4 requires preimage eui||sfn_le (=3385405908), which exists only in test/vectors/generate.py:_hop_hash (line 144), never called by lichen runtime. python/tests/test_vectors.py:1562 recomputes with the same generator helper (self-referential).

3) Same vector expected_slot=42 unreachable: slot_for(eui,12345,ns)==42 has ZERO solutions for ns in [2,4096] (fnv(eui)=4073988029; exhaustive scan). Vector provides no num_slots input; no surface derives 42.

4) ccp16-desync.json desync_recovery_beacon_revalidate pins expected="joined" after ONE valid beacon. Implemented spec 14.7 FSM (lichen/timing/sfn.py:98-114): DESYNCED+valid beacon -> RECOVERING (consecutive_valid=1); SYNCED requires 3 consecutive valid beacons; an invalid beacon during RECOVERING returns to DESYNCED. Pinned in module as xfail(strict=True).

5) ccp16-desync.json excessive_clock_drift_desync has NO enforcement surface: drift_ppm=12000 > guard_ppm=5000 premise holds arithmetically (60ms vs ~25ms over superframe_ms=5000), but no Python module reads a ppm guard to trigger desync recovery; no desync_recovery()/epoch_floor function exists anywhere in python/src/lichen. Skipped UNDRIVABLE in module.

6) Timing-window fields are prose-only: ccp9-rendezvous.json scheduled_rendezvous valid_until_sfn=12350 (TDMAScheduler has no validity window) and ccp16-hop.json rendezvous_beacon_announce next_rendezvous_us=1000000 (no scheduling surface consumes it).

7) ccp9_rendezvous.json announce_channel_parse_roundtrip labels wire byte 2 "expected_flags"=2; AnnounceMessage (lichen/announce/messages.py:109-115) has no flags field - that byte IS rx_channel. Value matches (2==rx_channel=2); label does not.

8) ccp9_rendezvous.json known_peer_synchronized_hop_preference description claims CCP-12 overrides pure announce rendezvous, but the implemented priority chain (lichen/link/channel.py:108-141) ranks announce-driven FIRST, above GNSS-synced hopping. Numeric pin (channel 5 via sim synchronized_hop_channel(1000,0,8)) is driven faithfully.

Evidence paths relative to repo root; module: python/tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py (48 passed, 2 skipped-undrivable, 2 xfailed-strict; gates: ruff clean, tests/test_vectors.py baseline 676 passed unchanged).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-25T19:54:30.970449Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-25T19:54:30.970449Z"}
